title: Phantom Studios sues JioStar India in Bombay High Court over ‘Queen’ sequel, seeks ₹250‑crore damages
description: Phantom Studios has sued JioStar India before the Bombay High Court for ₹250 crore alleging that the film ‘Queen Forever’ is an unauthorised sequel to the 2014 hit ‘Queen’ and amounts to a breach of their co‑production and intellectual property arrangements [Phantom Studios v. Jiostar India & Anr]The plea is likely to be listed for urgent hearing before Justice Gauri Godse this week.Justice Gauri GodsePhantom has claimed that it along with JioStar (earlier Viacom18) are joint and equal owner
